The presence of a lowest common ancestor between Fluoxymesterone and Danazol at the level of Therapeutic Androgen suggests a shared functional or structural basis for their interaction with Esr1. The final score of 0.7093 indicates a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, supported by the hierarchical inclusion of these entities in the network.
